title: Least-Squares Plane & Line Fit (PCA)
hints: Centre first: mu = mean, C = sum (p-mu)(p-mu)^T. Never fit z = ax + by + c (it can't represent vertical planes and it minimises vertical, not orthogonal, error).
`Eigen::SelfAdjointEigenSolver<Eigen::Matrix3d>` returns eigenvalues in ascending order: plane normal = col(0), line direction = col(2).
Degeneracy: plane needs λ1 clearly > 0 (not collinear); line needs λ2 > 0 (not all identical). Compare against λ2 (relative), not an absolute epsilon.
